_doc: CANONICAL node->atom mapping (Coherence-by-derivation SS6, Phase A, 2026-07-27). The single place that ties each front-door MODEL-ON-A-PAGE diagram node (site/index.html .node) to the named maturity-map atom(s) whose completion its stage claim rests on. Everything downstream (Phase B computed stage, Phase C site render, Phase D publish-gate disagreement check) derives from THIS file -- it is never hand-synced. Source of truth for what exists: docs/design/THE_MODEL_ON_A_PAGE.md. Atom ids reference docs/design/maturity_map.yaml (READ-ONLY here -- that path is a schema_sim_structure gate; this file never edits it).
_derivation_rule: A node's stage is a pure function of its mapped atoms' levels (docs/design/maturity_map.yaml level_current vs level_target): LIVE = every mapped atom at target; BUILDING = at least one below target; PLANNED = none started (all at level 0). Phase A does NOT compute stage -- it fixes the mapping and proves it coheres (every node has atoms, every atom ref is live, diagram and mapping agree on the node set). 'declared_stage' records the stage the live site currently HAND-SETS, so Phase D can flag drift between it and the computed stage.
_mapping_discipline: A node maps to the atoms that EMBODY its CURRENT (Timeframe-1) claim -- the set that must all be at target for that claim to hold -- NOT every atom in the topical vicinity. Timeframe-2 deepening atoms (registered-but-not-yet-true) are excluded by design; they belong to the evolution, not the live claim. This keeps the mapping honest in both directions: it neither cherry-picks to force green nor dumps unrelated atoms to force red.
